newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil shares up 5.35 pct on power, telcom sectors.
newsitem.headline: Brazil shares up 5.35 pct on power, telcom sectors.

text.p: Brazilian shares extended early gains and were 5.35 percent higher in late morning trade, led by power and telecommunications stocks, brokers said.
The Bovespa index .BVSP of the 47 most active stocks was up 604 points at 11,896 points at 1125 local/1425 GMT. Total market turnover rose to 309.1 million reais ($286.2 million).
Federal power holding Eletrobras preferred jumped 7.95 percent to 584 reais, while benchmark Telebras preferred was 5.28 percent higher at 149.50 reais.
Traders said the market is recouping some of last week's heavy losses, with investors returning to the bolsa to rebuild positions.
Share prices plunged 15 percent last week amid concerns over currency devaluation.
They also said apparently banks, local mutual funds and players covering short positions in the futures index market are heading the buying.

Analysts noted, however, the market could lose ground later in the session after its sharp rebound this morning. Also, the bolsa could tread water mid-afternoon while U.S. Federal Reserve Chairman Alan Greenspan speaks.
